showcase.zh: 实例框是一个框：它开出的那一样东西只在框里有名字，框里证出的结论不能再提到它；光看说明，容易把它当成<part-ref to="part:exI"></part-ref>的反面、一步就完
showcase.en: take the one there is is a box: the thing it opens has a name only inside it, and what is proved there may not mention it; from its description alone it is easy to take it for the reverse of <part-ref to="part:exI"></part-ref>, done in a step

hint.zh: 框里给那一样东西起名 a，拆开，再拿它举例。
hint.en: Inside the box, name the thing a, split, and use it as the example.

t.zh: <part-ref to="part:exE"></part-ref>用来处理存在命题：接入「∃x. …」，在元件上为存在的对象取名 a，框内便可使用它满足条件这一假设。a 只是框内的临时名字，框外的结论不能提到它，未解除的其他假设也不能包含它。
t.en: <part-ref to="part:exE"></part-ref> uses an existential statement: connect “∃x. …” and name the existing object a on the part. Inside the box, you may assume that it satisfies the condition. The name a is temporary: it must not appear in the conclusion outside the box or in other open assumptions.

after.zh: 「有这么一个，不妨叫它 a」：数学证明里也常这么说。
after.en: “There is one; call it a”: mathematical proofs say this often too.
